* Quads and tris
* Flat shading

* Single mesh, watertight
* 358 faces, 272 vertices.

Texturing:
* Baked PBR textures, Diffuse, normal, roughness.
* 2048 x 2048 resolution (2K)
* png image format

results.name: Fast Food Combo – Game-Ready 3D Asset
results.description:
A stylized fast food tray featuring a classic cheeseburger, crinkle-cut fries, dipping sauce, and a soft drink in a red paper cup. Each item is carefully crafted with hand-painted textures and optimized topology for real-time rendering. Ideal for stylized scenes, casual games, VR experiences, or food-themed environments. This model adds a playful, appetizing touch to any 3D project.

Technical details:

Polycount: 10,666 tris

Textures: 2K PBR (Albedo, Normal, MetallicRoughness)

Modeled in: Blender

Textured in: Substance Painter

Compatible with: Unity Universal Render Pipeline

For portfolio presentation only. Not intended for commercial use.
